text: Stonefield Primary Ledger is live -- Payables, Receivables, Cash Management, and Fixed Assets all processing real transactions across three warehouses.
During the very first real close, Simone Alvarez noticed Corporate's cost center carrying freight and utility costs that actually belonged to Midwest, Southeast, and West.
The cause was one Subledger Accounting rule that fell back to a hardcoded Corporate cost center whenever an AP invoice had no purchase order.
Theo Branagh fixed the rule, re-created the affected period, and posted a correcting journal -- Arjun Mehta's AP distributions were correct the whole time.
Next: following a real invoice's full journey from entry through Subledger Accounting to the GL, and how Finance actually uses this day to day.
